facts.fact: Targeting defines the context in which ads appear by matching keywords to customer shopping queries
facts.quote: Targeting is the way you define the context in which you want your ads to appear

facts.fact: Customer shopping queries are words and phrases Amazon customers use to look for products
facts.quote: Customer shopping queries: words and phrases that Amazon customers use to look for products

facts.fact: Keywords are word combinations bid on in manual campaigns to match customers shopping queries
facts.quote: Keywords: word combinations that you bid on in manual campaigns to match customers shopping queries

facts.fact: Sponsored Products offers three targeting options: automatic, manual, and negative targeting
facts.quote: With Sponsored Products, you have three targeting options – Automatic targeting Manual targeting Negative targeting

facts.fact: Automatic targeting matches ads to keywords and products similar to the advertised product based on shopping queries and product information
facts.quote: With automatic targeting your ad is automatically matched with keywords and products that are similar to the product you are advertising

facts.fact: Automatic targeting uses four default strategies: close match, loose match, substitutes, and complements
facts.quote: There are four automatic targeting strategies: Close match Loose match Substitutes Complements

facts.fact: Close match automatic targeting shows ads to shoppers using search terms closely related to the advertised product
facts.quote: Close match. We may show your ad to shoppers who use search terms closely related to your products

facts.fact: Loose match automatic targeting shows ads to shoppers using search terms loosely related to the advertised product
facts.quote: Loose match. We may show your ad to shoppers who use search terms loosely related to your products

facts.fact: Substitutes automatic targeting shows ads to shoppers browsing detail pages of products similar to the advertised product
facts.quote: Substitutes. We may show your ad to shoppers browsing detail pages of products similar to yours

facts.fact: Complements automatic targeting shows ads to shoppers viewing detail pages of products that complement the advertised product
facts.quote: Complements. We may show your ad to shoppers who view the detail pages of products that complement your product

facts.fact: Manual targeting allows advertisers to manually select which keywords or products to target
facts.quote: With manual targeting, you can manually select which keywords or products you want to target

facts.fact: Negative targeting helps exclude keywords, products, or brands to optimize campaign performance and spend
facts.quote: Negative targeting helps you exclude the keywords, products or brands you do not want your ads associated with

facts.fact: Campaign targeting type cannot be changed once a campaign is live
facts.quote: Once the campaign is live, you will not be able to change the campaign targeting

facts.fact: Keyword targeting offers three match types: broad match, phrase match, and exact match
facts.quote: The three match types for keyword targeting are: Broad match Phrase match Exact match

facts.fact: Broad match offers ad exposure to shopping queries containing keyword terms in any order including variations and related terms
facts.quote: A shopping query can contain the keyword terms in any order. It may include singulars, plurals, variations, synonyms, and related terms

facts.fact: Phrase match requires search terms to contain all components of the targeted keyword in the same order
facts.quote: The search terms matched will contain all components of the targeted keyword in the same order

facts.fact: Exact match requires search terms to match the targeted keyword word for word with the same words and order
facts.quote: The search terms are matched word for word (same words and in the same order) with the targeted keyword

facts.fact: Keywords are not case-sensitive and must not exceed 10 words or 80 characters
facts.quote: Keywords are not case-sensitive. There is a maximum limit of 10 words per keyword and 80 characters

facts.fact: Branded keywords are directly associated with a brand including the brand name alone or combined with other words
facts.quote: Branded keywords are directly associated with your brand or a brand you sell. They include just the brand name as well as any combination of the brand name and other words

facts.fact: Category keywords are non-branded generic keywords that relate to any product or category
facts.quote: Category keywords are non-branded (generic) keywords that relate to any product or category

facts.fact: Product targeting allows targeting specific products, categories, brands, or other product features relevant to the advertised item
facts.quote: Product targeting is a type of manual targeting that allows you to target specific products, categories, brands, or other product features that are relevant to your advertised item

facts.fact: Product targeting ads are eligible for impressions on product detail pages and search result pages where the targeted product appears
facts.quote: When targeting a product, your ad will be eligible for impressions on its product detail page, as well as search result pages where the targeted product appears

facts.fact: Negative keywords help prevent ads appearing on shopping results pages that do not meet campaign objectives
facts.quote: Negative keywords help prevent ads appearing on shopping results pages that do not meet your campaign objectives

facts.fact: Negative keyword phrase match prevents ads from showing on shopping queries containing the complete phrase or close variations
facts.quote: Negative phrase: ads will not show on shopping queries that contain the complete phrase or close variations

facts.fact: Negative keyword exact match prevents ads from showing on shopping queries containing the exact phrase or close variation
facts.quote: Negative exact: ads will not show on shopping queries that contain the exact phrase or close variation

facts.fact: Dynamic bidding up and down is recommended to help maximize automatic campaign performance
facts.quote: We recommend using dynamic bidding up and down to help maximize performance

facts.fact: Dynamic down only bidding is recommended for optimizing based on return on ad spend
facts.quote: if you are looking to optimize based on return on ad spend (ROAS), then try a dynamic down only strategy

facts.fact: Campaign strategies include expand, promote, protect, conquest, upsell, and cross-sell
facts.quote: Expand: focus on high-traffic category keywords and products Promote: create a specific campaign to drive sales of products with coupons Protect: focus on branded keywords and targeting Conquest: target competitors products Upsell: use keywords geared towards higher-priced items Cross-sell: target products in adjacent categories

facts.fact: Ad groups can contain a maximum of 1,000 products
facts.quote: You can add a maximum 1,000 products per ad group

facts.fact: Different targeting strategies should not be mixed within the same campaign and ad group
facts.quote: We recommend that you avoid mixing different targeting strategies within the same campaign and ad group

facts.fact: Amazon recommends letting automatic campaigns run for about two weeks before creating manual campaigns
facts.quote: We recommend that you let your automatic campaign run for about two weeks before creating a manual campaign

facts.fact: Testing different keyword match types should continue for at least 1-2 weeks before pausing keywords
facts.quote: Test different match types for at least 1-2 weeks to gather enough data before pausing any keywords

facts.fact: Negative keywords should be evaluated after receiving at least 20 clicks before adding as negative targets
facts.quote: we recommend evaluating its performance after it has received at least 20 clicks
